# Third-party files

These files are included unchanged so that Fan Control works on Windows without extra downloads. They are not part of Fan Control and keep their own licenses.

| File | What | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PawnIO_setup.exe` | PawnIO driver installer, signed by namazso | 2.2.0 | PawnIO: GPL-2.0 (`licenses/PawnIO-COPYING.txt`) | <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO>, installer from <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0> |
| `LpcIO.bin` | PawnIO's signed LpcIO module (Super I/O port access) | 0.2.11 | LGPL-2.1 (`licenses/PawnIO.Modules-COPYING.txt`) | <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules> |

SHA-256, matching the official release files:

```
1f519a22e47187f70a1379a48ca604981c4fcf694f4e65b734aaa74a9fba3032  PawnIO_setup.exe
b3896a1cab0d808fca31fe2ebcae045d59dac690da87b17c858bb8da357eb45e  LpcIO.bin
```

The source code of both is available at the links above.
